reason: This PR directly changes core planner join-reorder logic and a conflict-detection algorithm, and is explicitly framed as a correctness fix. Join reordering sits on optimizer semantics with broad blast radius: wrong legality checks can silently produce invalid plans or wrong-query results across many joins. The touched paths include the main reorder rule, joinorder internals, and plan base code, which is central enough and risky enough to justify a focused deep review for Blocker/High issues.
